name: Inocencio Gonzales — a daughter Juana baptised in July 1895, Sacaca, Potosí, Bolivia
researcher_question: Inocencio Gonzales (also Gonzalo) and his wife Antonia Uraque (also indexed Elsaque) are known from their daughter Victoria's Potosí marriages of 1905 and 1914, which give her birth as about 1886. What other children did Inocencio and Antonia have?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 2, hint-samples.csv row 91, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-23 as a TRUE MATCH (independent second opinion: Isaac Boateng). The 1895 Sacaca baptism of Juana Gonsalo (ark:/61903/1:1:6CB7-Y7JY; hinted persona = her father's, ark:/61903/1:1:6CB7-Y7JB), daughter of Inocencio Gonsalo and Antonia Araque, is accepted as a daughter of the subject Inocencio Gonzales (GY75-S9D) and his wife Antonia (indexed Uraque/Elsaque/Araque). Resolved on the FamilySearch INDEX; image_basis false — the register image (ark:/61903/3:1:33S7-9Y94-9J21) was NOT read under a licensed calibration, so Isaac's register-only details (legitimate; two days old; 'Antonia Oraque') are not relied upon; the indexed mother name 'Antonia Araque' and indexed place 'Sacaca, Alonzo de Ibáñez, Potosí, Bolivia' are used.
